Our standard ask is: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates, and their respective officers, directors, employees and agents" (or similar). If SkyData wants a more specific naming, we should confirm that the carrier can append the named additional insured endorsement with that exact entity text.

Delivery timeline: broker can produce a COI within 3-5 business days after we request it; the carrier endorsement sometimes takes longer (7-10 days) if an insurer issuance is needed. If they need the endorsement by 2027-03-28, we should confirm now so we can expedite the broker request.
